atoms.sound: When I’m on the road, I should be careful about my safety, and the safety of other road users.

instruction.text: Read the scenario and help the children make the right and safe decision by filling in the gaps.

atoms.b: He should ((++not absolutely)) keep going, otherwise he might fall off or have other ((++accidents journeys)).

atoms.a: Mike wants to listen to loud music through his headphones on his way to the library.
atoms.b: It'd be ((++safer dangerous)) to not listen to music while on the road. It’s important to be able to ((++hear smell)) everything, such as a car horn.

atoms.a: Frida is wondering whether she should ride her bike in the pouring rain.
atoms.b: In bad weather like rain, snow or ice, your bike is more likely to ((++skid travel)). For this reason, Frida should either ride very ((++slowly quickly)) or take the bus instead.

atoms.a: Tian wants to cycle as fast as possible
atoms.b: It would be better not to do that. When you cycle quickly, you can lose ((++control your_tyres)) and injure yourself or other ((++road_users vehicles)).
